description: Deposits, withdrawals, loan payments, account opening, and balance inquiries in the lobby and drive-up
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Vital member services (749.1): members must reach their money the same day; an interruption projected past 2 business days is a catastrophic act reportable within 5 business days (748.1(b)); about 60 lobby and drive-up transactions a day
manual_workaround: Core offline teller mode using the nightly balance file (withdrawals up to $500 per member per day; deposits post when the core returns); paper receipts

description: Balances, transfers, bill pay, e-statements, and mobile deposit for about 3,900 enrolled members
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Vendor-hosted and reachable even if the office is down; members rely on it for bill pay and transfers; an outage of a day drives calls and complaints
manual_workaround: Phone and lobby service; post a notice on the website; bill pay items queue at the provider

description: Take wire requests, verify the member, key the wire (maker), approve it (checker), and confirm with the member
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Home closings and vehicle purchases are same-day; average wire about $38,000, so one fraudulent or failed wire exceeds the Severe cost threshold; an unauthorized wire may trigger SAR, NCUA, and member notices
manual_workaround: Corporate credit union phone-initiated wire with PIN (never tested); callbacks by cell phone if the office phones are down
dependent_third_parties: Corporate credit union; core processor; internet provider
dependent_people_or_facilities: Senior MSR (maker); Operations Manager and Accounting and Compliance Officer (checkers)

description: Card authorizations at merchants and ATMs; the lobby ATM; card fraud monitoring
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The card processor authorizes in stand-in mode with limits if the core is down, so members can still use cards for a day
manual_workaround: Card processor stand-in authorization; lobby ATM out of service notice; cash at the teller line

description: Post incoming payroll and benefit deposits, member bill payments, and share draft (check) clearing through the core
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Members depend on payroll and benefit deposits on the posting date; late posting causes returned payments and fees for members; settlement runs daily
manual_workaround: Core processor posts ACH files at its data center; credit union reviews exceptions the next day; waive resulting fees

description: Online and in-person consumer loan applications, credit reports, AI credit scoring, decisions, and adverse action notices
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Regulation B notice timing is measured in days (12 CFR 1002.9(a)(1): 30 days); applications can wait 2 to 3 days without harm
manual_workaround: Paper applications; manual underwriting without the AI score; tell applicants of the delay

description: Phones, email including the shared Member Services mailbox, and the document imaging server (signature cards, ID copies, loan files)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Phones are needed for wire callbacks (BP-03), so their RTO is 4 hours even though the process is Moderate; imaging records are needed to verify signatures and identities
manual_workaround: Forward the main number to a staff cell phone; verify identity with ID in person; request re-sent documents
dependent_third_parties: Internet provider; productivity suite vendor; MSP; cloud IaaS provider

description: General ledger and reconcilements, BSA monitoring and SAR filing, the quarterly Call Report, and payroll through a payroll service
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: SAR deadlines are counted in days (748.1(d)(2): 30 calendar days from initial detection); reconcilements are month-end vital records (749.1)
manual_workaround: Work from the prior day's core reports; payroll service repeats the prior payroll
